question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I signed this science project ______ London.
solution:
The correct answer is '**in**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given underlined part '**in**' should be used.
 
• '**In**' is '(used to show place) inside or to a position inside a particular area or object'. [(पूर्वसर्ग) (स्‍थान क
